# Dominick's quality report

Checks the Dominick's store-department file for problems before cleaning: rows per year and per store, summary statistics, zeros and very low customer counts. These findings set the cleaning rules for this dataset.

*Generated by `src/01_download/reports/dominicks_quality_report.py`.*

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Rows | 324,133 |
| Stores | 128 |
| Date range | 1980-01-03 to 2009-06-11 |
